name: timeline-gantt
title: Timeline gantt
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Workstream Gantt with task bars, optional progress, a duration-weighted group summary, dependency curves, a today marker, and a sticky scale. Hover opens a detail card. An edit sheet reports a patch and does not write the items.

meta.descriptionEs: Barras por frente con avance, resumen de la fase, dependencias y un panel que pide cambios sin guardarlos.

examples.title: Taller Bruma
examples.description: Semana, mes o día. El avance y el panel son del anfitrión. Datos inventados.

examples.title: Marco de estrés
examples.description: 320px, vacío, carga, error, token largo y cuarenta tareas.

meta.usage:
<TimelineGantt
  items={items}
  workstreams={workstreams}
  scale="week"
  now="2026-10-25T18:00:00.000Z"
  editingId={editingId}
  onEditingIdChange={setEditingId}
  onTaskChangeRequest={(id, patch) => setItems(applyGanttTaskPatch(items, id, patch))}
/>

api.name: items / workstreams
api.description: Controlled records. TMeta is never read. deps are ids of other items.

api.name: scale / onScaleChange
api.description: Controlled or uncontrolled. The header stays sticky while the scale scrolls.

api.name: onSelect / onHover
api.description: A bar click selects. Hover and focus open the detail card and report the item.

api.name: now / locale / weekStartsOn
api.description: Default locale es-MX and Monday. now places the today line. Pass it in tests.

api.name: loading / error / disabled
api.description: Loading and error replace the grid. disabled keeps it visible and blocks the bars.

api.name: labels / className
api.description: Spanish chrome. timelineGanttLabelsEn is the English set.

api.name: progress
api.description: Optional fraction 0–1 (0.5 is 50%). Below 0 and above 1 clamp. In development, above 1 warns and is not read as a percent. NaN draws the solid status bar.

api.name: workstreamProgress
api.description: Pure rollup weighted by inclusive days. Missing progress is left out, not counted as 0. Milestones and inverted ranges weigh 0. An empty group returns null.

api.name: editingId / onEditingIdChange / onTaskChangeRequest
api.description: The sheet is controlled. Save emits a patch. The host writes items, usually with applyGanttTaskPatch. End must be on or after start.

docs: Clean-room schedule. Pass items with id, workstream, label, start, end, status, and optional deps. Dates are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD and the day is read in UTC. progress is an optional fraction from 0 to 1 (0.5 is 50%, 1 is 100%). Values below 0 or above 1 clamp. In development, a value above 1 also warns; it is not read as a percent. NaN is ignored and the bar stays the solid status color. The fill uses scaleX, foreground on a muted track, and a foreground border so the amount is not color alone. Group rows show a duration-weighted summary only when that group has a known ratio. Tasks with no progress are left out of that ratio. A group with no known ratio shows its name and count only, not 0% and not a stand-in label. milestone tasks and ranges whose end is before the start weigh 0. An empty group has no percent. onSelect, onHover, and onTaskChangeRequest do not write the items. editingId opens the sheet; the host applies the patch. The sheet's progress field is a percent from 0 to 100 and the patch stores the fraction. End must be on or after start. Arrow keys move between bars. The scale header stays pinned while the timeline scrolls sideways. The today line uses now, which should be a stable timestamp in tests. Reduced motion skips the bar fade and the fill scale. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, empty, field, input, label, sheet, skeleton, or tooltip-card. The item ships no theme. Shadcn Studio Gantt Chart 04 is a Pro reference: layout and interaction only. No mockup source, copy, colors, or assets were copied.
